corrections.reason: Canonical Ge'ez Gospel of Luke 15:14 root word 'ወአንፈቆ' (and when he had spent all); the horizontal bar and bottom loop of 'ፈ' were misread as 'ሊ'.
Amharic Andemta formula 'እስካለው' (up to where it says); the shortened right leg of 4th-order 'ካ' is visible in the image.
Canonical Ge'ez Luke 15:22 'አልባሰ ቅድመ' (the first/best robe); ink bleed between the two loops of 'መ' made it resemble 'ወ'.
Patristic Ge'ez citation 'አስተሐምሞተ አኀው ዓቢያን ከመ ዘለንዑሳን እንዲል' requires the verbal noun prefix 'አስተ-' (1st order 'አ'), which matches the printed glyph.
